d:
The Indian men's hockey team clinched a hat-trick of Asian Champions Trophy titles with a commanding 4-1 win over Japan in the final at Mohali.
After an early setback, India bounced back through goals from Shilanand Lakra, Dilpreet Singh, Jugraj Singh and Vivek Sagar Prasad to seal their sixth title. India also maintained an unbeaten run throughout the tournament, while Japan's wait for their maiden title continued.
